title: MOSS-Music: what blocks the media preflight, proven
method: Four Modal compatibility runs, each eliminating one hypothesis; the fourth printed TorchCodec's own diagnosis.

runs.change: TorchCodec CPU wheel replaced with the CUDA-matched build of the same version (0.8.0+cu128, pinned by URL and SHA-256).
runs.reason: TorchCodec's native ops library links against the libtorch it was built for; a CPU build is the wrong artifact for a cu128 runtime.
runs.result: The image built and the wheel installed; the run then failed on the wheel-provenance comparison, not on the import.

runs.change: compatibility.py decodes the recorded wheel URL before comparing it.
runs.reason: A local version (+cu128) is served percent-encoded, so the previous comparison could never match any CUDA wheel.
runs.result: The comparison passed and the media preflight ran for the first time.

runs.change: The compatibility verify runs on a T4 GPU container.
runs.reason: The runtime under validation is a CUDA runtime; validating media decode on a CPU-only container tested an environment MOSS never serves in.
runs.result: Still failed, and the preflight reported only that it had failed.

runs.change: preflight.py names the exception class and its message, with absolute paths redacted.
runs.reason: A preflight that says only "it failed" cannot be fixed; the original blocker had been recorded for two days on that basis.
runs.result: TorchCodec printed: 'Could not load libtorchcodec. Likely causes: 1. FFmpeg is not properly installed ... 2. The PyTorch version (2.9.1+cu128) is not compatible with this version of TorchCodec.'

conclusion: FFmpeg 7.1.1 is installed from conda-forge with its shared libraries on LD_LIBRARY_PATH, and the FFmpeg-7 core library was reached in the very first run, so cause 1 is excluded. The remaining cause is the one TorchCodec names with the exact Torch version: TorchCodec 0.8.0 does not support Torch 2.9.1. MOSS-Music upstream already requires TorchCodec 0.9.*; the SGLang branch's 0.8.0 pin is what this worker followed.
resolution: Q-01: move the worker to the upstream runtime (TorchCodec 0.9.*), then re-run this same verify.
notDone: No endpoint was deployed and no promotion was signed.
Both MOSS providers remain BLOCKED_UPSTREAM and stay out of provider routing.
